prompt: a single hexagon that masks a hypnotic forward motion kaleidoscope
statement: This sketch creates an endlessly shifting kaleidoscopic pattern that fills the entire canvas with intricate, flowing geometries. The visualization combines multiple rotating layers of hexagonal patterns with gradient-filled triangles, all moving in synchronized yet independent motion. A persistent hexagonal mask defines a central region that obscures some of the movement while allowing others to flow around it, creating an illusion of depth and complexity. The animation is entirely self-contained, driven by time-based calculations that ensure continuous visual evolution without any user interaction required.
